rationale: NI019 describes Nernst dependence andNI020 computes half-cell potentials without pH/temperature variation. Current titration does neither; remaining b752 Nernst and other partners survive. NI012 occupational significance is a different judgement from performing/analyzing redox titration. Removing its extra2fdd target is justified; original source clause and remaining1df mapping survive.1df is a broad criteria-based judgement goal, not proof of the complete occupational component. Its specific completion remains expressly unproved.
BYC11OtherMethodsRemainSeparate: Thin-layer chromatography, acid-base methods and general method/safety duties retain separate contributor obligations. This redox-titration review does not close the whole C11 clause.
BWNamedIodometryPreserved: The third full case has supervised iodate/iodide/thiosulfate procedure, late starch addition, raw readings, blank correction, six-to-one balance and actual-observation rubric. It does not substitute manganometry for iodometry.
